original_card.question: Does one quantified step of the proposed #4100 all-size construction hold at its actual caller?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read PROOF.md and AUDIT.md in #4100. Select one distinct obligation: CRT total repair, native/free-algebra lifting, precision/conditioning, or complete fixed-tape cost. This is an author-submitted proof, not an accepted unconditional theorem.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Check live handoffs; name one proposition, its caller, quantified domain and dependency closure. Independently prove the implication or exhibit a precise gap/counterexample. Prioritize CRT.md total repair or COMPLEX.md free-algebra lift only if unclaimed. Stop at the chosen obligation; do not substitute finite samples or root arithmetic for an all-size proof, or launch the complete package by default.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: One CRT repair, native lift, precision/conditioning or tape-cost proposition, with its exact caller.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.
Treating archive intake, an author PASS receipt or a finite composed fixture as discharge of the universal hypotheses.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: proposed unconditional construction and finite checks, without independent acceptance.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent proof audit of one caller-bound all-size implication; all other premises remain explicit.

actual_scope: Audit PR4100 CRT.md section 4: arbitrary source functions at completed compact endpoints, literal inverse on all dirty addresses, and source-bound exact repair at the Beneš CRT caller.
scope_change_reason: Select the caller-specific CRT algebraic implication requested by revision 7. Reuse PR763’s generic repair and carry lemmas; do not repeat them as new results or audit the complete asymptotic construction.
bottleneck_link: The proposed all-size CRT route must restore every dirty address at each switch. This checks one algebraic premise of that route; tape cost, reservoirs and the other multiplication interfaces remain separate.
stop_rule: Stop after the quantified caller proof, four complete finite domains, 1024 seeded multi-target comparisons, the actual ten-layer CRT fixture and five weakened-contract controls. Do not run whole supplier/native/ordinary admission or change selected kappa.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the quantified argument. RESULT.json records 77824 exhaustive parameter/function states, 1024 seeded states, 4096 addresses through ten caller layers and five semantic controls. verify.py recomputes the receipt and authenticates six source inputs.
author: Hiroki KUMAZAKI (@kumagi), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in source research, derivation, implementation, writing and scoped agent review. Not independent human peer review or proof-assistant formalization.

open_questions.question: Does the actual CRT caller supply the omitted reservoir fields and complete ordered translations with its stated fixed-tape tariff?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This audit establishes the address identity conditional on that physical caller contract, not its asymptotic implementation.
open_questions.first_step: Choose one batch in PR4100 CRT.md sections 3–4 and bind the exact source-function dependency set, reservoir placement and charged full-field shuttles; preserve the audited all-target omission.
open_questions.blocked_by: Separate caller/tape-cost audit; finite address fixtures cannot discharge it.

open_questions.question: Can a physical exception-stream implementation evaluate the explicit inverse and full destination keys within the stated E(p,ell) control bound?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The direct inverse removes a finite lookup oracle from the algebraic replay but does not certify the claimed machine cost.
open_questions.first_step: Implement one current-state inverse key using encoded sequential controls, then account for head return, erasure and full high digits before scaling the argument.
open_questions.blocked_by: A concrete fixed-tape control evaluator and its cost proof.
